title: The Army That Lost a War to Birds

beats.visual: soldiers march beside a truck toward camera
dry wind, empty water trough, emu tracks
emus tear through wheat and snap fence wire
Major Meredith points while gunner loads Lewis gun
large emu flock crests the hill
emus split around truck as soldiers turn
low angle, dam reeds, gun aimed across water
Lewis gun recoils, jams, smoke and stunned gunner
soldiers run after dust trail while emus escape
farmers raise a continuous fence as emus pass behind
